verdict.rationale: Ironclad documents a first-party guide for bulk-launching workflows via its REST API, and a data-export job API that pulls contract data in bulk. These are genuine bulk operations, but the evidence covers only these narrow cases, with a single thin mention of the bulk-launch flow. Missing for 10: bulk update or edit of records/contracts, bulk actions beyond workflow launch and export, details on batch limits and behavior, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
